$comment: S-194 one-click demo data (docs/runbooks/demo.md § One-click demo data). Read by ca.northline.tools.demo.DemoSeed. Every business, person and listing is FAKE. No place names (region-neutral): the city, province, zones and coordinates come from the configured default market. Prices in cents (CAD), durations in minutes. Keys are stable: ids are derived from them, so a re-run updates instead of duplicating. `photo` is a slot of the photo library (web/packages/media, docs/runbooks/photos.md); a listing without one gets its category's photo; `owner` = the demo owner account, otherwise the business has its own (sign-in-less) owner. `hours` (kitchens) are the opening hours every day in the market's time zone.
